items.title: OpenAI 年化營收接近 500 億美元，但較早前流傳數字低 200 億
items.title_en: OpenAI's Revenue Is $20 Billion Below Earlier Projections
items.summary: 《金融時報》指 OpenAI 年化營收「接近 500 億美元」，比外界流傳的 700 億低 200 億，差距源於雲端夥伴銷售入帳方式不同。IPO 時程延至 2027 年初，公司正承受更大的商業化壓力。
items.summary_en: The Financial Times reports OpenAI's annualised revenue is 'approaching $50 billion' — roughly $20 billion below the ~$70 billion figure circulated days earlier, a gap explained by different accounting conventions for cloud-partner sales. The IPO has been delayed to early 2027.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 營收低於預期恐推動 OpenAI 加速商業化，API 定價與功能閘門或連帶調整。
items.why_en: Revenue shortfall may pressure OpenAI to accelerate monetisation, potentially triggering API pricing or feature-gating changes for enterprise customers.
highlights: 《金融時報》揭露 OpenAI 年化營收實為接近 500 億美元，非流傳的 700 億美元，差距約 200 億。
差異來自雲端夥伴收入入帳方式，並非業績造假，但影響估值與 IPO 時程，延至 2027 年初。
商業化壓力加劇，API 客戶應評估多供應商備份策略，以防定價或條款變動。
highlights_en: OpenAI's annualised revenue is approximately $50 billion, some $20 billion below the widely cited $70 billion figure.
The gap stems from how cloud-partner revenue is booked, not misreporting, but affects valuation and pushes the IPO to early 2027.
Agencies with OpenAI-dependent tools should evaluate multi-vendor hedging as commercial pressure intensifies.
items.detail:
OpenAI 的財務規模爭議，實際上源自一個技術性的入帳分歧，而非業績造假。根據《金融時報》的調查，此前在投資者圈子流傳的 700 億美元年化營收數字，是部分機構投資人為了與 Anthropic 的財務口徑對齊而自行推算得出的結果。Anthropic 在計算年化收入時，將透過亞馬遜 AWS 及 Google Cloud 等雲端合作夥伴所產生的銷售額一併計入；OpenAI 則沿用較為保守的入帳方式，僅記錄直接進帳的部分，這導致兩家公司的數字在形式上無法直接比較，外界估算因此出現系統性偏差。

將近 500 億美元的年化營收，對於一家成立至今不過十年的科技公司而言仍屬驚人規模，然而這個數字需要放在 OpenAI 的支出結構中才能理解其財務健康程度。根據 2025 年外洩的財務文件，OpenAI 當年度的總收入約為 130 億美元，而總支出已超過收入，公司整體仍處於虧損狀態。今年 3 月 OpenAI 完成了一輪高達 1,220 億美元的融資，估值之高史無前例，但如此龐大的資本注入，也進一步加劇了市場對其盈利時程表的審視。

首次公開招股（IPO）時程被推遲至 2027 年初，背後反映的是 OpenAI 內部仍在積極調整企業治理架構，從非營利主體向商業公司過渡的法律與財務工程尚未完成。對於正在評估是否加深 AI 技術投入的香港及台灣代理商而言，此事最直接的啟示在於供應商風險管理：一旦單一 AI 服務商的財務透明度存在疑問，依賴其 API 作為核心業務基礎的企業便需審慎評估備援方案。在 AI 服務訂閱費用日益龐大的當下，建立多供應商架構並非只是技術選擇，而是商業連續性規劃的必要一環。

值得注意的是，Anthropic 目前的年化收入約為 65 億美元（截至今年 7 月），規模僅為 OpenAI 的八分之一左右，兩者的市場滲透率仍有顯著差距。然而 Anthropic 積極透過雲端夥伴計算的入帳方式，使其在宣傳增長速度時佔有敘事優勢。市場對於 AI 頭部企業商業模式的解讀，正變得愈發複雜，代理商在參考競品或技術供應商的公開財務數字時，需要具備辨別不同統計口徑的能力，避免將宣傳性數字誤作為選廠依據。
items.detail_en:
The $20 billion discrepancy in OpenAI's reported revenue is fundamentally an accounting methodology dispute rather than a case of financial misrepresentation. According to the Financial Times investigation, the widely circulated $70 billion annualized revenue figure originated from investors who attempted to create an apples-to-apples comparison with Anthropic's reported metrics. Anthropic includes revenue flowing through cloud distribution partners such as Amazon AWS and Google Cloud in its annualized run rate calculations, while OpenAI applies a more conservative recognition approach that counts only direct bookings. This structural difference made the two figures inherently incomparable, and the systematic overestimation went unchallenged in investor circles for months.

The nearly $50 billion annualized figure, while still remarkable for a company less than a decade old, must be understood alongside OpenAI's cost structure. Leaked 2025 financials showed approximately $13 billion in total revenue against spending that exceeded that figure, leaving the company in a net loss position. The record-breaking $122 billion fundraising round completed in March 2026 provides a substantial runway, yet it also intensifies market scrutiny over the path to profitability and the timeline for a sustainable business model.

The IPO delay to early 2027 reflects ongoing complexity in OpenAI's transition from its original nonprofit governance structure to a fully commercial entity. The legal and financial engineering required for this restructuring is not yet complete, and public markets will demand greater disclosure standards than what private investors have accepted. For marketing agencies in Hong Kong and Taiwan that have built workflows around OpenAI's API stack, the core strategic implication is vendor risk diversification. When a primary AI supplier's financial transparency is questioned, the operational continuity of API-dependent services becomes a legitimate business concern — multi-vendor architecture is no longer merely a technical preference but a business continuity necessity.

The contrast with Anthropic's $6.5 billion annualized run rate (as of July) underscores how differently the two companies have positioned their distribution strategies. Anthropic's cloud-partner-inclusive accounting creates a narrative advantage in showcasing growth velocity, even as its absolute scale remains roughly one-eighth of OpenAI's. Agencies evaluating AI vendor selection should develop internal frameworks for parsing the accounting differences between competitor financial claims — treating publicly stated revenue figures as starting points for due diligence rather than definitive benchmarks.

items.title: Anthropic 更新使用政策：明確禁止選舉干預、虛假帳號與影響力操作
items.title_en: Anthropic Updates Usage Policy: Bans Election Interference, Fake Accounts, and Influence Campaigns
items.summary: Anthropic 修訂 Claude 使用條款，新增三大禁用範疇：操縱選民或選舉流程、以虛假帳號或偽造媒體機構散播影響力操作、對實體硬體的未授權自動控制。同步收緊武器軟體與監控濫用限制。
items.summary_en: Anthropic revised Claude's usage policy with three new sections: explicit prohibition on deceiving voters or disrupting elections; banning fake accounts, fabricated news outlets, and influence campaigns; and restricting autonomous control of physical hardware without human oversight.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 以 Claude API 建立的自動化內容管線若涉及政治議題或社交媒體發布，需即時審查是否觸犯新政策。
items.why_en: Agencies running Claude-powered content pipelines touching political topics, social media publishing, or automation must audit for compliance before the US election blackout on Oct 27.
highlights: 明確禁止利用 Claude 欺騙選民、干擾選舉結果或選舉基礎設施。
新增禁止虛假帳號、偽造新聞媒體、或任何形式影響力操作的條款，覆蓋 API 所有用途。
代理商以 Claude 建置的自動發帖、社交監聽機器人或競情爬取工具，需在美國選舉封期（10 月 27 日）前完成合規審查。
highlights_en: New policy explicitly bans using Claude to deceive voters, disrupt elections, or attack election infrastructure.
New clauses prohibit fake accounts, fabricated news outlets, and any form of covert influence campaigns via the API.
Automated social posting, listening bots, or competitive scraping tools built on Claude must be reviewed for compliance before the US election blackout starting Oct 27.
items.detail:
Anthropic 此次政策修訂最值得深究的，是「欺騙性活動」（Deceptive Campaigns）這一全新整合章節的設立。過去，禁止虛假帳號、偽造新聞機構及協調影響力操作的相關規定分散於不同條款之中，執行上容易出現詮釋漏洞；此次整合後，無論是政治性還是商業性的欺騙行為，均納入同一禁用框架。這意味著利用 Claude 製作用於大規模社群媒體自動發帖的腳本、或以偽裝成獨立評論者身份的帳號進行品牌護航，均可能直接觸犯新政策，而非僅落入灰色地帶。

選舉相關章節的調整方向則出乎部分觀察者預料。Anthropic 將原有的「禁止一切個人化投票與選舉動員推廣」條款予以刪除，改採更精準的「禁止欺騙選民、干擾選舉程序」表述。這一鬆綁源自實際使用反饋：原有的廣泛禁令無意間阻礙了合法的公民教育應用，例如多語言選民資訊傳播或無黨派投票指引製作。新版措辭試圖在打擊惡意干預與保護合法公民科技應用之間尋求更精細的平衡，生效日期為 2026 年 11 月 12 日。

對於從事自動化行銷工具開發或社群媒體管理服務的代理商，新政策最直接的合規挑戰在於「持續性自動發帖」與「影響力操作」之間的邊界界定。Anthropic 並未提供詳盡的量化標準，而是以「意圖欺騙公眾對某議題的真實輿論分布」作為判斷基準。在實務中，這要求代理商在以 Claude API 構建自動化內容發布工具時，需確保帳號身份透明、發帖頻率與行為符合所在平台規範，並保留使用者真實授權的可稽核記錄。

此外，新政策對涉及實體硬體控制的應用場景亦作出明確規範：凡是將 Claude 連接至可操控物理設備的系統，營運商必須確保人類監督員能夠隨時介入並終止操作，且硬體在 Claude 連線中斷時應能自動回歸安全狀態。此條款雖主要針對工業自動化與機器人場景，對代理商直接影響有限，然而它清晰地勾勒出 Anthropic 對 AI 自主行為邊界的整體立場，亦為業界未來在智慧廣告投放系統及程序化媒體購買中導入 AI 決策設立了監管預期的基準線。
items.detail_en:
The most substantively significant element of Anthropic's policy revision is the consolidation of previously scattered rules into a unified 'Deceptive Campaigns' section. Previously, prohibitions on fake accounts, fabricated media outlets, and coordinated influence operations existed in separate policy clauses, creating interpretive gaps that sophisticated actors could exploit. By grouping both political and commercial deception under one enforceable framework, Anthropic has raised the compliance bar for operators building Claude-powered automation tools — particularly those deploying mass social media posting scripts or brand reputation management systems that rely on accounts with unclear identity disclosure.

The adjustment to the elections section surprised some observers because it represents a deliberate narrowing rather than expansion of restriction. The blanket ban on personalized voter targeting and campaign mobilization has been removed. Anthropic's stated rationale is that the original broad prohibition was inadvertently blocking legitimate civic applications: multilingual voter information services, nonpartisan voting guides, and civic education tools were being caught in the same net as malicious interference campaigns. The revised language focuses specifically on voter deception and election process disruption, taking effect November 12, 2026.

For agencies building automated content tools or social media management services on Claude's API, the central compliance question concerns the boundary between legitimate automation and influence operations. Anthropic does not provide quantitative thresholds. The governing test appears to be whether the activity is designed to deceive the public about the true distribution of opinion on a topic. In practical terms, this requires that automated posting tools built on Claude maintain transparent account identities, operate within platform-native behavioral norms, and retain auditable records of genuine user authorization for each action taken.

The new hardware control requirements — mandating that operators connected to physical devices maintain human override capability and ensure safe-state fallback on disconnection — have limited direct relevance to marketing agencies today. Their significance lies in establishing a clear regulatory expectation: Anthropic is drawing a firm line around the scope of AI autonomous action. For agencies evaluating AI integration into programmatic media buying or automated campaign optimization systems, this signals that compliance frameworks for AI-assisted decision-making will become increasingly specific and enforceable as the technology matures.

items.title: Manus 完成逾 5 億美元 A 輪融資，騰訊入股、探索香港 IPO
items.title_en: China's Manus Raises $500M+, Tencent Backs It, Explores Hong Kong IPO
items.summary: Butterfly Effect（Manus 母公司）完成逾 5 億美元融資，博裕資本與 IDG 領投，騰訊、華山投資、真格基金跟投。此前 Meta 20 億美元收購案在 2026 年 4 月遭中國監管機構否決。Manus 已推出 Manus 2.0，並重開北京辦公室，同步探索香港 IPO。
items.summary_en: Butterfly Effect (parent of Manus AI agent) raised over $500M led by Boyu Capital and IDG Capital, with Tencent participating, following the collapse of Meta's $2B acquisition blocked by Chinese regulators in April 2026. Manus 2.0 is live, a Beijing office has reopened, and the company is exploring a Hong Kong IPO.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 騰訊加持加上探索港交所上市，Manus 在中國市場的自動化代理生態將快速擴張，代理商服務內地品牌需關注其影響。
items.why_en: With Tencent's backing and a Hong Kong IPO on the horizon, Manus is positioned to expand rapidly in China's agentic AI layer — agencies serving mainland brands should evaluate Manus 2.0 as an emerging automation infrastructure in the China market.
highlights: Manus A 輪逾 5 億美元，騰訊、博裕資本、IDG 聯合入股，估值較 Meta 收購要約顯著提升。
Manus 2.0 為每位代理人分配電郵地址、電話號碼與數位錢包，能在現有應用程式上層自主完成任務。
探索香港 IPO，與內地品牌合作的港台代理商應密切追蹤 Manus 在企業端的採用進度。
highlights_en: Manus raised $500M+ with Tencent, Boyu Capital, and IDG backing — a significant step up in valuation from Meta's blocked $2B offer.
Manus 2.0 assigns AI agents their own email addresses, phone numbers, and digital wallets to autonomously operate above existing apps.
A Hong Kong IPO is being explored; agencies working with mainland China brands should track enterprise adoption of Manus as an agentic commerce layer.
items.detail:
Butterfly Effect 此輪融資的完成，標誌著 Manus 正式走出 Meta 收購案失敗的陰影，並以獨立商業實體的姿態重新確立市場地位。此前於 2025 年 12 月宣布的 20 億美元收購協議，在今年 4 月遭中國監管機構以「防止 AI 核心人才外流」為由強制叫停；Meta 與 Butterfly Effect 隨後歷時數月完成資產分割，過程中涉及部分用戶數據依協議條款刪除，並重新啟動北京辦公室的人員招募。此輪由博裕資本與 IDG 資本領投、騰訊等機構跟投的 A 輪融資，不僅是資金補充，更是一次明確的本土資本背書，有助於化解外界對其監管合規性的疑慮。

Manus 2.0 的技術架構升級，是理解此輪融資吸引力的關鍵背景。相較於初代產品，Manus 2.0 在多代理人協同方面有顯著強化，能夠將複雜任務分解並分派至多個子代理人並行執行，再整合輸出結果。而隨 2.0 同步推出的獨立應用程式 Cue，為 AI 代理人賦予了獨立的電子郵件地址、電話號碼及數位錢包，使其能夠以具備身份認證的數位行為者身份自主完成跨系統任務，而無需人類在每個步驟進行授權操作。這一設計突破了傳統 AI 助理的「問答閉環」，向真正意義上的自主業務代理邁進了一步。

對香港及台灣的數位行銷代理商而言，Manus 的融資動態之所以值得持續追蹤，在於其企業採用曲線與當地市場的潛在交集。Manus 在 Meta 收購案期間的年化經常性收入已超過 1 億美元，顯示其在非企業用戶中已具備相當規模的付費意願。隨著 Manus 2.0 針對企業場景優化，加上 Cue 提供的自動化業務流程能力，這類工具在廣告投放管理、跨平台數據整合及客戶服務自動化等代理商核心業務中的適用空間，值得提前進行技術評估。

香港 IPO 的探索則為本地市場提供了一個更直接的觀察視角。若上市計畫落實，Butterfly Effect 將成為首批在香港資本市場掛牌的大陸 AI 代理人公司之一，其招股書將強制披露的財務細節與用戶數據，有機會成為業界評估 AI 代理人工具商業落地程度的第一手參考資料。代理商可透過此時間窗口，在市場估值與技術期望值尚未充分校準前，提前積累對此類工具的實操認知。
items.detail_en:
Butterfly Effect's completed funding round marks Manus's definitive re-establishment as an independent commercial entity following the collapse of the Meta acquisition. The $2 billion deal announced in December 2025 was unwound in April 2026 after Chinese regulatory authorities intervened on grounds of preventing the outflow of core AI talent. The subsequent separation process — which included deletion of certain user data per agreed terms and the reopening of the Beijing office for fresh hiring — took several months to resolve. The Series A, led by Boyu Capital and IDG Capital with participation from Tencent and others, functions simultaneously as capital infusion and domestic institutional endorsement, helping to neutralize market uncertainty about Manus's regulatory standing within China.

The technical architecture of Manus 2.0 is central to understanding the investment thesis. The updated platform features significantly enhanced multi-agent coordination, enabling complex task decomposition across parallel sub-agents with consolidated output synthesis. The simultaneously launched standalone application Cue represents a more substantive architectural departure: by assigning AI agents their own email addresses, phone numbers, and digital wallets, Cue enables agents to operate as identity-verified digital actors capable of completing cross-system tasks without requiring human authorization at each step. This design moves meaningfully beyond the traditional question-and-answer loop of AI assistants toward genuinely autonomous business process execution.

For digital marketing agencies in Hong Kong and Taiwan, Manus's trajectory is worth monitoring because of the potential intersection between its enterprise adoption curve and regional market demand. The company's annualized recurring revenue exceeded $100 million even prior to the Meta deal period, demonstrating substantial paid user willingness in the prosumer segment. As Manus 2.0 optimizes for enterprise use cases and Cue introduces automated workflow capabilities, the applicability of these tools to core agency functions — campaign management, cross-platform data consolidation, and customer service automation — warrants early technical evaluation before market pricing fully reflects the product's maturity.

The potential Hong Kong IPO creates a more proximate observation opportunity for regional practitioners. If the listing proceeds, Butterfly Effect would become one of the first mainland AI agent companies to access Hong Kong's capital markets, with mandatory prospectus disclosures providing industry-first financial and user data benchmarks for assessing the commercial maturity of this category of tools. The current window — before market valuations and technology expectations are fully calibrated — is strategically valuable for agencies seeking to build firsthand operational knowledge ahead of broader enterprise adoption cycles.

items.title: Nous Research 融資 9,000 萬美元，估值 15 億，推出企業版 Hermes 代理人
items.title_en: Nous Research Raises $90M at $1.5B Valuation, Launches Hermes for Businesses
items.summary: Nous Research 完成 9,000 萬美元 B 輪融資，估值 15 億美元，英偉達、Union Square Ventures 及三星參投。其開源模型 Hermes 在 HuggingFace 累計 2,400 萬次下載，企業版 Hermes for Businesses 同步上線，年收入目標 1 億美元以上。
items.summary_en: Nous Research raised a $90M Series B at a $1.5B valuation backed by Nvidia, Union Square Ventures, and Samsung. Its open-source Hermes model has 24 million HuggingFace downloads; enterprise-tier 'Hermes for Businesses' has launched, targeting $100M+ ARR.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 開放權重代理人可在私有雲部署，符合香港《個人資料（私隱）條例》及台灣數據法規的資料留境要求。
items.why_en: Open-weight models deployable on-premise or private cloud address data-residency requirements under Hong Kong PDPO and Taiwan data regulations — a credible alternative to locked-in SaaS AI tools.
highlights: Hermes 是 HuggingFace 被 clone 最多的 AI 模型，下載量達 2,400 萬，企業版今日正式開放。
開放權重設計可在私有雲或本地部署，適合處理客戶敏感數據的代理商，減少數據外流風險。
英偉達與三星同步入股，強化 Hermes 在企業 AI 基礎設施的戰略地位。
highlights_en: Hermes is the most-cloned model on HuggingFace with 24 million downloads; the enterprise tier is now generally available.
Open-weight architecture allows on-premise or private-cloud deployment — ideal for agencies handling sensitive client data under PDPO or Taiwan data laws.
Nvidia and Samsung's participation signals Hermes is becoming strategic enterprise AI infrastructure, not just a developer curiosity.
items.followup: 此次融資與企業版代理人發布，與 10 月 8 日我們報過的「pubX 融資 500 萬美元、AdCP 代理人廣告協議」屬不同賽道：pubX 是廣告交易基礎設施，Nous Research 是通用開放權重語言模型。兩者均顯示 AI 代理人生態在不同層次加速融資，但服務對象與技術棧截然不同。
items.followup_en: This raise and enterprise agent launch is distinct from the pubX/M AdCP story on Oct 8: pubX is ad-transaction infrastructure; Nous Research builds general-purpose open-weight LLMs. Both signal accelerating funding across different layers of the AI agent ecosystem, but serve completely different use cases and technical stacks.
items.detail:
Nous Research 的崛起路徑，在當前 AI 投資浪潮中頗為特殊：這家公司以開源模型起家，在幾乎不依賴大型企業客戶合約的情況下，透過開發者社群的自發傳播積累了驚人的規模基礎。Hermes 系列模型在 HuggingFace 上累計超過 2,400 萬次複製下載，令其成為該平台被 clone 次數最多的模型，背後驅動的是數以萬計的獨立開發者、研究機構與中小型企業將其嵌入自有產品與工作流程的實際需求。根據公司估算，Hermes 系列目前貢獻了全球 AI Token 消耗量的約 2.5%，以一家創立僅三年的公司而言，這是一個罕見的技術滲透指標。

此輪 B 輪融資由 Robot Ventures 領投，英偉達、Union Square Ventures、Menlo Ventures 及三星共同參與。英偉達的入股具有戰略訊號意義：作為 AI 運算基礎設施的主導供應商，英偉達選擇投資一家以開放權重模型見長的公司，折射出其對「分散式 AI 生態」長期佈局的判斷——開放模型生態愈繁榮，對 GPU 算力的需求就愈高。三星的參與則可能預示硬體端側部署的合作潛力，尤其是在三星旗下半導體與移動設備業務對私有化 AI 推理需求日益增長的背景下。

企業版 Hermes for Businesses 的推出，是 Nous Research 從「開發者工具」向「企業解決方案」轉型的關鍵一步。與公有雲端 API 模式最大的差異，在於開放權重架構允許客戶將模型完整部署於自有私有雲或本地端環境，無需將任何業務數據傳輸至外部伺服器。對於香港及台灣受《個人資料（私隱）條例》或《個人資料保護法》規管、同時需要處理敏感客戶數據的代理商而言，數據留境能力是選擇自主部署 AI 工具時的核心考量，而非可選項目。

財務指標方面，Nous Research 截至今年 9 月中的年化營收已達約 3,600 萬美元，公司預計在年底前突破 1 億美元大關。若此預測實現，將意味著公司在短短數個月內實現三倍速的收入增長，這一增速在開源 AI 領域甚為罕見，亦是英偉達等策略性投資者此時入場的重要背景。對代理商的實務啟示在於：Hermes for Businesses 的開放部署特性，使其成為構建內部 AI 工具時值得納入評估清單的候選方案，尤其適用於需要高度客製化且對數據隔離有嚴格要求的場景，例如品牌聲量監測、競品分析及客戶報告自動化生成。
items.detail_en:
Nous Research's growth trajectory is distinctive within the current AI investment landscape. The company built its foundation almost entirely through open-source model distribution rather than enterprise contract acquisition, accumulating extraordinary scale through organic developer community adoption. The Hermes model series has been cloned over 24 million times on HuggingFace, making it the platform's most-cloned model — a figure driven by tens of thousands of independent developers, research institutions, and small-to-medium enterprises embedding it directly into their own products and workflows. The company estimates that Hermes accounts for approximately 2.5% of global AI token consumption, a remarkable penetration metric for a company only three years old.

The Series B was led by Robot Ventures with participation from Nvidia, Union Square Ventures, Menlo Ventures, Samsung, and 1789 Capital. Nvidia's involvement carries strategic signal value: as the dominant supplier of AI compute infrastructure, Nvidia's decision to invest in an open-weight model specialist reflects its long-term thesis on distributed AI ecosystems — a more proliferative open model ecosystem generates proportionally greater demand for GPU compute. Samsung's participation suggests potential for edge deployment partnerships, particularly given Samsung's growing interest in private AI inference capabilities across its semiconductor and mobile device businesses.

The launch of Hermes for Businesses represents Nous Research's pivotal transition from developer tooling to enterprise solutions. The critical architectural distinction from public cloud API models is that the open-weight structure allows clients to deploy the model entirely within their own private cloud or on-premises environments, with no requirement to transmit business data to external servers. For Hong Kong and Taiwan agencies subject to the Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance or the Personal Data Protection Act respectively, and handling sensitive client data, data residency capability is a core procurement criterion rather than an optional feature when evaluating self-hosted AI tools.

On the financial side, Nous Research had reached approximately $36 million in annualized revenue as of mid-September 2026, with the company projecting it will surpass $100 million before year-end. If that projection holds, it implies roughly three-fold revenue growth within a matter of months — an exceptional velocity in the open-source AI segment and a key factor in the timing of strategic investors entering at this round. The practical implication for agencies is that Hermes for Businesses' open deployment architecture makes it a legitimate candidate for internal AI tool construction evaluation, particularly for use cases requiring deep customization and strict data isolation: brand sentiment monitoring, competitive intelligence analysis, and automated client reporting generation.

items.title: Anthropic 發布網路安全使命：CIDP 計劃保護關鍵基礎設施，OSS Scanner 免費開放
items.title_en: Anthropic Launches Cyber Mission: CIDP for Critical Infrastructure, Free OSS Scanner
items.summary: Anthropic 推出「網路安全使命」，包含關鍵基礎設施防禦計劃（CIDP）及免費開源安全掃描服務 OSS Scanner。CIDP 與 Palo Alto Networks 等合作夥伴保護電網、水務、交通系統；OSS Scanner 任何人均可免費使用。
items.summary_en: Anthropic launched its Cyber Mission comprising the Critical Infrastructure Defense Program (CIDP) — partnering with Palo Alto Networks and others to protect power grids, water, and transport — and OSS Scanner, a free AI-powered security scanning service for open-source projects.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.followup: 10 月 7 日我們報過 Anthropic 開放三層網路安全驗證計劃（CIDP），合作夥伴已發現逾 12.9 萬個軟體漏洞。今日 Anthropic 正式將計劃升級為「網路安全使命」全套框架，除現有驗證計劃外，新增免費開源安全掃描工具 OSS Scanner，兩合計構成 Anthropic 網路防禦的完整公共層。
items.followup_en: On Oct 7 we covered Anthropic's three-tier cybersecurity verification program (CIDP), with partners having found 129,000+ software vulnerabilities. Today Anthropic formally elevated this into a full 'Cyber Mission' framework — adding the free OSS Scanner on top of the verification program to complete its public cyber-defence layer.
items.why: 代理商使用的開源工具與第三方整合，可免費用 OSS Scanner 進行安全核查，降低供應鏈風險。
items.why_en: Agencies can now use OSS Scanner for free to audit open-source tools and third-party integrations in their martech stacks, reducing supply-chain risk at no cost.
highlights: OSS Scanner 免費開放，任何使用開源工具的企業均可掃描程式庫，核查軟體安全漏洞。
CIDP 計劃持續擴大合作夥伴網路，覆蓋電力、水務、交通等關鍵基礎設施的 AI 防禦。
Anthropic 預測兩年內 AI 將在網路安全整體上「有利於防禦方」，但強調當前風險仍處高位。
highlights_en: OSS Scanner is free for anyone to use, enabling agencies to audit open-source dependencies for security vulnerabilities at no cost.
CIDP continues expanding its partner network to cover AI-powered defence of power, water, and transport critical infrastructure.
Anthropic projects AI will broadly 'favor defense' over offense within two years, but acknowledges near-term risks remain elevated.
items.detail:
Anthropic 此次「網路安全使命」的核心邏輯，在於承認 AI 技術同時降低了攻防兩端的門檻，而防守方在工具採用速度上長期落後於攻擊方。CIDP（關鍵基礎設施防禦計劃）的設計正是針對這一不對稱困境：與其在通用平台上推廣安全能力，不如直接進入電力、水務、交通、製造業等高風險場域，透過 Accenture、Booz Allen、Deloitte、PwC 等顧問巨頭，以及 CrowdStrike、Palo Alto Networks、Dragos、Nozomi Networks 等網路安全專業商，在客戶現場部署前沿 Claude 模型與 Anthropic 的工程師資源。目前 CIDP 已覆蓋逾半數美國州級及地方政府，支援範圍涵蓋程式碼掃描、修補管理、事件應變與紅隊演練。

OSS Scanner 的技術架構借鑑了 Google OSS-Fuzz 的協作模式，以選擇加入（opt-in）方式向開源專案免費提供周期性漏洞掃描。每份報告由 Anthropic 最強力的模型生成，包含概念驗證漏洞利用範例、成因說明及修補建議，預計真陽性率超過 90%。對於有充足人手進行分類篩選的專案維護者，Anthropic 可直接提供未經人工審查的批次發現；其餘則依協調式漏洞揭露（CVD）流程，在人工核實後再行通報。這項服務源於更早期的 Project Glasswing，該專案已累積掃描數百個開源專案，並發現漏洞通報至修補之間往往相隔數月。OSS Scanner 的免費運營由 2026 年 8 月成立的「Defender Advantage Fund（0xDAF）」提供資金支持，基金同時資助 Python Software Foundation、OpenSSF、Apache 等重要開源生態組織。

與此同時，Anthropic 本周亦完成了 Cyber Verification Program（CVP）與 Project Glasswing 的整合，向各規模的安全專業人員、維運人員及系統維護者提供擴展的 Claude 網路安全能力存取，並放寬部分阻斷分類器的限制，以支援滲透測試、逆向工程分析等合法安全研究需求。對行銷科技與數位廣告產業而言，這一系列動作的意義不僅止於資安層面：廣告技術堆疊日益依賴開源元件，供應鏈攻擊對廣告投放平台的潛在威脅不容忽視，OSS Scanner 的免費開放意味著廣告技術供應商有機會以零成本強化底層安全防線。Anthropic 預測在未來兩年內，AI 整體上將有利於防守方，但承認在防守工具普及之前，攻擊方仍享有一定的短期優勢窗口。
items.detail_en:
Anthropic's Cyber Mission, launched October 8, 2026, addresses a structural asymmetry in cybersecurity: AI lowers the cost of both attack and defense, but defensive adoption has historically lagged. The Critical Infrastructure Defense Program (CIDP) tackles this head-on by embedding frontier Claude models and on-site Anthropic engineers directly within operational technology (OT) environments — power grids, water systems, transportation networks, and manufacturing facilities — that cannot be taken offline for patching and often run decades-old proprietary equipment. The founding partner cohort of 11 organizations spans consulting (Accenture, Booz Allen, Deloitte, PwC), pure-play cybersecurity (CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, CrowdStrike), OT/ICS specialists (Dragos, Nozomi Networks, Insane Cyber), and industrial equipment manufacturers (Hitachi, Rockwell Automation). Since June 2026, a predecessor program has already served more than half of all US state and local governments, delivering code scanning, patch management, incident response, and red-team exercises.

The OSS Scanner is modeled after Google's OSS-Fuzz and offers free, opt-in periodic vulnerability scanning for open-source projects. Each report is model-generated without human review — enabling faster delivery — and includes a proof-of-concept exploit, root-cause explanation, and suggested fix where available. Anthropic targets a true-positive rate above 90%. High-triage-capacity maintainers can receive raw bulk findings; others go through a coordinated vulnerability disclosure (CVD) pipeline with human verification. The service grew out of Project Glasswing, which identified a chronic problem: months often passed between vulnerability discovery and patching. The Defender Advantage Fund (0xDAF), launched in August 2026, keeps the scanner free and supports organizations including the Python Software Foundation, OpenSSF, and the Apache Software Foundation.

A third track — the Cyber Verification Program (CVP), merged with Glasswing this week — widens access to Claude's full cybersecurity capabilities for security professionals, operators, and maintainers of any organization size, with relaxed blocking classifiers to support legitimate penetration testing and reverse engineering. For marketing technology teams, the practical implication is direct: ad-tech stacks increasingly depend on open-source libraries, making supply-chain attacks a genuine vector. OSS Scanner now offers a zero-cost way to audit those dependencies. Anthropic's two-year forecast predicts AI will ultimately favor defenders — lower-friction pre-ship bug detection, secure-by-default code generation, and active AI-assisted monitoring — while acknowledging a near-term window where offensive tooling may retain the edge as defensive adoption catches up.

items.title: Google 推出企業版 Gemini 代理人：設定目標、跨 Workspace 與 Jira 自主執行任務
items.title_en: Google Launches Agentic Gemini for Businesses: Set Goals, Execute Autonomously Across Workspace
items.summary: Google 在 Cloud 發布會推出企業優先的 Gemini 代理人，接受「目標」而非僅回答問題，自主規劃並跨 Google Workspace、Slack、Jira、Snowflake 及任何 MCP 伺服器執行任務。代理人擁有獨立職場身份（電郵地址），可調用子代理，甚至選用 Anthropic Claude 模型。
items.summary_en: Google launched an enterprise-first Gemini agent at a Cloud event that accepts 'objectives, not just instructions' and autonomously plans and executes tasks across Google Workspace, Slack, Jira, Snowflake, and any MCP server. The agent has its own workplace identity (email address), can delegate to subagents, and can select models including Anthropic Claude.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: 代理商日常工作流程（活動報告、簡報整理、跨平台排程）可由 Gemini 代理人接管，節省大量人手操作時間。
items.why_en: Campaign reporting, brief compilation, and cross-platform scheduling — core agency workflows — can now be delegated to a Gemini agent that operates autonomously across the Google Workspace stack agencies already use.
highlights: 企業版 Gemini 代理人可接受「目標」並自主規劃執行步驟，整合 Workspace、Slack、Jira、Snowflake。
代理人擁有獨立電郵地址與職場身份，可調用子代理分工，並從多個 AI 模型（包括 Claude）中選擇最適者。
已使用 Google Workspace 的代理商應立即申請試用，將例行報告與跨平台任務委派給代理人，釋放人手處理高價值工作。
highlights_en: Enterprise Gemini agent accepts objectives and autonomously plans multi-step execution across Workspace, Slack, Jira, and Snowflake.
The agent has its own email address and workplace identity, can spawn subagents, and selects from multiple AI models including Anthropic Claude.
Agencies on Google Workspace should pilot this immediately to delegate routine reporting and cross-platform tasks, freeing junior hours for higher-value work.
items.detail:
Google 此次企業版 Gemini 代理人的架構突破，在於將 AI 助手的互動模式從「問答」升級為「委託」：用戶提交的是一個目標（objective），而非一連串指令。代理人接收目標後，自行拆解為子任務，選擇最適合的底層模型——系統預設為最優模型路由，亦允許企業指定切換至 Anthropic Claude 等第三方模型，未來還將支援開源及私有部署模型——並依序協調各子代理完成執行。整個過程在「任務收件匣」介面中完整呈現，包含推理軌跡、子代理調用記錄、技能載入狀態及進度追蹤，確保工作流程對操作人員全程透明、可稽核。

整合廣度是此版本的另一個關鍵差異化優勢。代理人原生支援 Google Workspace（文件、雲端硬碟、Gmail、Calendar）、Microsoft 365、Slack、ServiceNow，以及開發與數據工具鏈中的 Jira、Confluence、Git、BigQuery、Databricks、Postgres、Snowflake。更重要的是，任何符合 MCP（Model Context Protocol）規範的伺服器——無論內部自建或外部第三方——均可直接接入，意味著企業無需等待 Google 原生支援即可擴展代理人的作業範圍。代理人在 iOS、Android、Windows、Mac 及 CLI 上均可存取，定價模式提供多模型編排、智能路由及即時支出上限等選項，降低大規模部署的成本不確定性。

對於廣告代理商而言，最值得關注的是這套架構的「獨立身份」設計：每個代理人擁有獨立的 Workspace 電子郵件地址、行事曆感知能力，以及對組織架構與時區的上下文理解。所有代理人行動的稽核軌跡歸屬於代理人本身而非人類操作者，確立了明確的責任歸屬框架。On、Shopify、PayPal 已成為早期採用者，BNP Paribas、Merck、Ulta Beauty 等大型企業用戶亦已導入。Google 選擇以企業市場優先發布，明確聲明是為了在消費者端推出前，先解決安全性、規模化與性能方面的深層課題。已使用 Google Workspace 的代理商，現在申請試用即可取得優先體驗資格，在競爭對手掌握同等工具前建立操作熟練度。
items.detail_en:
Google's enterprise-first Gemini agent marks a fundamental shift in how AI is deployed in the workplace: rather than responding to prompts, it accepts objectives and autonomously plans and executes multi-step work across an organization's entire software ecosystem. The architecture centers on a task inbox that surfaces the agent's reasoning chain, subagent delegation calls, skill-loading events, and live progress tracking — giving operators full visibility without requiring manual supervision. Model selection is automated by default, routing each subtask to the optimal available model, but enterprises can override to specify Anthropic Claude or, in future updates, open-source or on-premise models. This multi-model orchestration layer is a notable strategic move: Google is building a coordination platform that transcends its own model lineup.

The integration surface covers the tools enterprises already live in. On the productivity side: Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, and ServiceNow. On the engineering and data side: Jira, Confluence, Git, BigQuery, Databricks, Postgres, and Snowflake. Beyond named integrations, any MCP (Model Context Protocol) server — internal or third-party — can be connected directly, giving organizations a standards-based path to extend the agent's reach without waiting for Google to build native connectors. The agent is accessible across iOS, Android, Windows, Mac, and CLI, with pricing options including smart model routing and real-time spend caps to manage cost at scale.

The identity architecture deserves particular attention from agency professionals. Each agent instance receives its own Workspace identity: an email address, calendar awareness, and organizational context including team structure and time zones. Actions are audit-trailed to the agent entity, not the human who deployed it, creating a clear accountability framework for compliance-sensitive environments. Early adopters include On, Shopify, and PayPal; established enterprise customers include BNP Paribas, Merck, and Ulta Beauty. Google's decision to launch business-first — explicitly citing the need to resolve security, scale, and performance challenges before a consumer rollout — signals a deliberate maturation strategy. Agencies already on Google Workspace can apply for early access now, with the opportunity to develop operational fluency before competitors reach the same capability level.

items.title: Meta 廣告週發布會：Advantage+ 影片生成正式開放、Business Agent 自主調整預算
items.title_en: Meta at AWNY: Advantage+ Video Generation Goes GA, Business Agent Adjusts Budgets Autonomously

The Meta Ads MCP server has been expanded for third-party AI integration.

items.followup: 10 月 6 日我們報過廣告週紐約 2026 揭幕，AI 正式進入代理商議程。今日 Meta 在活動現場公布具體工具：Advantage+ 靜態轉影片功能已全面開放，Business Assistant 升級具備自主調整廣告的代理能力，Meta Ads MCP 伺服器同步擴展——由宏觀趨勢落地為可即日使用的功能。
items.followup_en: On Oct 6 we covered AWNY 2026 opening with AI entering agency agendas as a mainstream topic. Today Meta delivered concrete tools: Advantage+ video generation is GA, Business Assistant now has autonomous ad adjustment capability, and the Meta Ads MCP server has expanded — the macro trend now has specific tools agencies can deploy today.
items.why: Advantage+ 靜態轉影片功能即日可用，可零製作成本將現有產品圖轉化為影片廣告，適合立即測試。

Business Assistant 升級為代理人，可透過對話自主生成創意、調整定向與預算，並設定 Customer Lifecycle Strategy 確保 AI 建議符合品牌方向。

highlights_en: Advantage+ Creative video generation is now generally available in all Ads Manager accounts — repurpose static product images into video at no production cost.
Business Assistant is now agentic: it can autonomously generate creatives, adjust targeting and budgets via conversation, with Customer Lifecycle Strategy keeping AI recommendations brand-aligned.
